title: Chapter 773 System; Powerful!
content:
Chapter 773 System; Powerful!

Chapter 773 System; Powerful!

The Green-faced King and the Deadly Twin Beasts raised their eyebrows and quickly pulled out their weapons, ready to attack at any time.

"Bang!"

"Bang!"

However, before they could make their next move, the three of them were sent flying like the men in black earlier. They spat out a large mouthful of blood and were completely silent.

Silence.

The entire place fell silent.

Jiang Xiaoyue and the others opened their mouths wide, looking a little stunned.

Those were the Green-faced King and the Deadly Twin Beasts on the Heaven Rankings!

In the blink of an eye, he was defeated?

Who was this young hero Lin?

How high was his cultivation?

Lin Fan didn't care about the shocked people and said," Let's go."

When Jiang Xiaoyue heard this, she came back to her senses and stammered,"Ah…" Ah... Alright."

The group continued to move forward.

When they arrived at the entrance of the Hao Zai Trading Company, another group of men in black rushed out.

"Hualala!"

However, before these men in black could do anything, some of them even couldn't run out completely before they all vomited blood and fell to the ground dispiritedly.

This scene shocked Jiang Xiaoyue and the others.

Lin Fan said," I've sent you all here safely. How are you going to thank me?"

Originally, Jiang Xiaoyue was prepared to give him a very profound cultivation technique.

But now that he saw how powerful Lin Fan was, he felt that the skill might not be of much use to him.

She opened her mouth but couldn't say anything.

Lin Fan smiled," What? You don't want to thank me?"

"Thank you, thank you. Young hero Jiang, please wait for me for a moment." Jiang Xiaoyue hurriedly said.

After saying that, she rushed into the Hao Zai Lai Trading Company.

After a while, she took out a sword with a cold light and an ancient book.

Lin Fan took it and said," You gave me two gifts. I'll return one to you."

As soon as he finished speaking, he casually waved his hand, and a golden stream of light directly entered Jiang Xiaoyue's body.

Suddenly, a clear notification sounded in Jiang Xiaoyue's mind.

[Ding! [The paywall system has been successfully bound.]

Jiang Xiaoyue was stunned.

A paywall system?

[The paywall system. A system that can become stronger after spending money.]

You can become stronger just by spending money?

There was such a thing in the world?

When Jiang Xiaoyue raised her head and wanted to ask Lin Fan, he had already disappeared.

Then, Jiang Xiaoyue bought some things with the intention of giving it a try.

The next moment, her eyes widened.

That was because her strength had indeed increased!

The system was actually real!

....

Of course it was true.

All these years, Lin Fan had created quite a few systems out of boredom.

This spending money to become stronger system was just one of them.

Furthermore, it could only be considered a very ordinary one, the upper limit could only reach the universe level.

At this moment, Lin Fan's body flashed and he appeared on a planet billions of kilometers away.

The environment of this planet was similar to that of Earth, and it had a lot of water resources.

Lin Fan couldn't help but be curious as he used his spirit to scan the area.

Sweeping around, Lin Fan found a familiar face.

It was Little Rock.

At this moment, there was a delicate and pretty girl beside Little Rock. They looked at each other with shy expressions.

This was... The stone bloomed?

Lin Fan's face revealed a strange look.

He leaped and flew toward Little Rock.

....

Little Rock and the girl came to a jewelry shop and prepared to go in and take a look.

At this moment, a tall middle-aged man happened to walk over.

"Xiao Qin!" the middle-aged man said in a deep voice.

"Father," the girl said nervously.

"Why are you still with him?!" The middle-aged man asked sternly.

"Father, he treats me very well…" Xiao Qin said.

"Good? What's the use? He's not worthy of you at all!" the middle-aged man said.

" He's very talented," Xiao Qin said." He'll definitely become a strong person in the future."

The middle-aged man sneered." There are many talented people in this world. He's nothing. Don't be fooled by him. Come here quickly!"

As he spoke, he reached out to pull Xiao Qin over.

Little Rock quickly took a step forward and vaguely protected Little Qin behind him.

" What?" The middle-aged man's face turned stiff." You want to have a fight with me?"

Xiao Qin tugged at Little Rock's clothes and shook her head slightly.

Obviously, she didn't want Little Rock and his father to be unhappy.

"Whoosh!"

At this moment, a tall and handsome figure suddenly appeared beside him.

"Greetings, Master." Little Rock bowed respectfully when he saw him.

The middle-aged man's face turned even uglier when he heard that." Did you see that, Xiao Qin?" he asked in a deep voice. He was just a servant! Hurry up and come over!"

He looked as if he would lose face if Little Rock and Little Qin stayed any longer.

"Rumble!"

At this moment, a huge spaceship that covered the sky suddenly appeared in the sky.

Below the spaceship was a terrifying blood-red skull.

A terrifying aura surged down like a tsunami.

" Bloody Skeleton Pirate!" the middle-aged man exclaimed in shock.

" Xiao Qin, hurry up and leave. The blood skeletons have universe levels, and even king level warriors!"

Universe level, king level!

This was definitely a disaster that could not be resisted by ordinary planets.

"It's space pirates! Also, they are Blood Skeleton space pirates!"

"Heavens!"

"Help!"

"Run!"

"Hurry up and ask for help!"

The entire planet was filled with screams.

It was obvious that the Blood Skeleton Pirate was very famous. Many people had heard of his terror.

The entire planet fell into chaos.

At this moment, a deep voice sounded from the spaceship.

"Now, I want you to gather 100 billion crystals in one day! For every 100 million crystals that we lose, I, the Blood Skeleton, will kill 1% of the creatures!"

100 billion crystals!

It had to be said that this was definitely an exorbitant demand.

It would take at least 100,000 years to accumulate 100 billion crystals for a planet.

This was only a possibility.

If there were any more losses, they might not be able to gather them even if they sold the entire planet.

And Bamboo Star was obviously a planet that had been damaged.

Massacre was inevitable!

The entire planet wailed again.

Everyone was panicking to the extreme.

Lin Fan frowned," So noisy!"

As soon as he finished speaking, he raised his finger and pointed at the air.

"Whoosh!"

A dazzling energy beam shot into the sky.

In an instant, the massive Blood Skeleton Ship shattered like a bubble. A wave of energy spread out in all directions, causing a violent wind to blow across the entire Bamboo Planet.

His clothes and the trees shook and rustled.

Everyone's mouth was wide open, and their expressions were stunned.

Among them, the middle-aged man and Xiao Qin, who were standing beside Lin Fan, had the worst expressions.

Destroy the spaceship with a single finger!

He... Who was it?
